emoji_own.loading.defaultMessage: 正在載入你的自訂表情符號…
emoji_own.loading.description: On a page of the settings' Custom emoji while the reader's emoji and requests are read.

emoji_own.failed.defaultMessage: 無法載入你的自訂表情符號。
emoji_own.failed.description: On a page of the settings' Custom emoji when they could not be read, before Try again.

emoji_own.missing.defaultMessage: 此位址沒有你的表情符號，它可能已被刪除。
emoji_own.missing.description: At /settings/custom-emojis/{id} for an emoji that is not one the reader made, before the link back.

emoji_own.all.description: The link back to /settings/custom-emojis under the sentence that an address names no emoji of the reader's.

emoji_own.month.description: The heading of the section of what the reader used of their monthly limit of requests for new emoji.

emoji_own.quota.used.defaultMessage: 本月你可申請 {limit} 個表情符號，已申請 {used} 個。
emoji_own.quota.used.description: In This month: the approved and pending requests for new emoji the reader made this month (UTC), out of their limit.

emoji_own.quota.unlimited.defaultMessage: 本月你已申請 {used} 個表情符號。你沒有每月上限。
emoji_own.quota.unlimited.description: In This month, for a reader with no monthly limit.

emoji_own.quota.pending.defaultMessage: {count, plural, other {其中 # 個等待審核。}}
emoji_own.quota.pending.description: In This month: how many of the requests counted still wait for an administrator.

emoji_own.quota.resets.defaultMessage: 計數會在 {date} 重新開始。刪除表情符號不會退還申請額度。
emoji_own.quota.resets.description: In This month: the day the count of requests starts again, and that deleting an emoji does not lower it.

emoji_own.quota.reached.defaultMessage: 本月你可申請的表情符號已全部申請。{date} 起可再次申請。
emoji_own.quota.reached.description: In the place of Request an emoji once the reader reached their monthly limit, with the day it starts again.

emoji_own.request.new.description: The button that opens the form of a new request for a custom emoji, and the title of that form.

emoji_own.request.emoji.description: The heading of the section of a new request's shortcode and image.

emoji_own.request.send.description: The button of the submit bar of a new request for a custom emoji.

emoji_own.request.limit.defaultMessage: 本月你可申請的表情符號已全部申請，所以未送出。
emoji_own.request.limit.description: Beside Send request when the server refused it at the monthly limit.

emoji_own.request.state.defaultMessage: {state, select, pending {等待審核} approved {已核准} rejected {未核准} withdrawn {已撤回} lapsed {已失效：表情符號已刪除} other {{state}}}
emoji_own.request.state.description: Where a request of the reader's stands, the line under its shortcode.

emoji_own.request.asked.description: A fact of a request of the reader's: the day they made it.

emoji_own.request.reason.description: A fact of a request that was not approved: the reason the administrator wrote.

emoji_own.request.withdraw.description: The button of a waiting request that withdraws it, freeing its shortcode.

emoji_own.request.withdrawn.description: In Your requests once one was withdrawn (its shortcode between colons).

emoji_own.request.decided.defaultMessage: 此申請在此期間已有結果，所以未撤回。
emoji_own.request.decided.description: In Your requests when a withdrawal came after an administrator decided the request.

emoji_own.request.withdraw_failed.defaultMessage: 未能撤回申請。請檢查網路連線後再試一次。
emoji_own.request.withdraw_failed.description: In Your requests when a withdrawal failed.

emoji_own.shortcode.description: The field of the shortcode of a requested emoji, which texts write between colons.

emoji_own.shortcode.rule.defaultMessage: 2 到 30 個字母（A 到 Z、a 到 z）、數字和 _。區分大小寫，之後無法變更。
emoji_own.shortcode.rule.description: Under the shortcode of a requested emoji: the rule its value follows, also when it was refused.

emoji_own.shortcode.taken.defaultMessage: 此伺服器已有表情符號使用這個簡碼，或已有人申請。請選擇其他簡碼。
emoji_own.shortcode.taken.description: Under the shortcode of a request the server refused because it is taken or reserved.

emoji_own.image.description: The field of a requested emoji's image.

emoji_own.image.hint.defaultMessage: PNG、GIF 或 WebP，長邊不超過 1,024 像素。
emoji_own.image.hint.description: Under the image field of a request: what the server takes.

emoji_own.image.choose.description: The button of the image field of a request that opens the file picker.

emoji_own.image.another.description: The button of the image field of a request once one is picked.

emoji_own.image.none.description: In the place of the file's name in the image field of a request while none is picked.

emoji_own.image.missing.defaultMessage: 請選擇表情符號的圖片。
emoji_own.image.missing.description: Under the image field of a request when Send request was pressed without one.

emoji_own.image.format.defaultMessage: 請選擇 PNG、GIF 或 WebP 圖片。
emoji_own.image.format.description: Under the image field of a request when the server refused the file's format.

emoji_own.image.too_large.defaultMessage: 此檔案超過伺服器對表情符號的大小限制。請選擇較小的檔案。
emoji_own.image.too_large.description: Under the image field of a request when the file is over the server's size limit.

emoji_own.image.too_big.defaultMessage: 請選擇長邊不超過 1,024 像素的圖片。
emoji_own.image.too_big.description: Under the image field of a request when the image is too wide or tall.

emoji_own.image.failed.defaultMessage: 無法讀取圖片。請選擇其他圖片或重試。
emoji_own.image.failed.description: Under the image field of a request when the upload could not be processed.

emoji_own.requests.description: The heading of the section of the reader's requests for custom emoji.

emoji_own.requests.empty.defaultMessage: 你還沒有申請過表情符號。
emoji_own.requests.empty.description: In Your requests while the reader made none.

emoji_own.emojis.description: The heading of the section of the custom emoji the reader made.

emoji_own.emojis.empty.description: In Your emoji while the reader made none.

emoji_own.emoji.category.description: A fact of one of the reader's emoji: its category in the picker.

emoji_own.emoji.aliases.description: A fact of one of the reader's emoji: its aliases, each between colons.

emoji_own.emoji.hidden.description: A fact of one of the reader's emoji that the picker does not offer, though texts can use it.

emoji_own.emoji.disabled.description: At the end of the row of one of the reader's emoji that an administrator disabled.

emoji_own.emoji.disabled.about.defaultMessage: 管理員已停用此表情符號：它的 :shortcode: 在各處都會顯示為文字。
emoji_own.emoji.disabled.about.description: On the page of one of the reader's emoji that an administrator disabled.

emoji_own.emoji.description: The heading of the section of the image of one of the reader's emoji.

emoji_own.no_image.description: In the place of the image of one of the reader's emoji when it cannot be shown.

emoji_own.picker.description: The heading of the section of one of the reader's emoji's category, aliases and whether the picker offers it.

emoji_own.category.description: The field of the category of one of the reader's emoji; empty for none.

emoji_own.category.rule.description: Under the category of one of the reader's emoji when it is too long.

emoji_own.aliases.description: The field of the other names of one of the reader's emoji, which the picker finds it by.

emoji_own.aliases.hint.description: Under the aliases of one of the reader's emoji.

emoji_own.aliases.rule.defaultMessage: 最多 {max} 個別名，每個 2 到 30 個字母、數字和 _。
emoji_own.aliases.rule.description: Under the aliases when one breaks the rules of a shortcode or there are too many.

emoji_own.visible.description: The setting of whether the emoji picker offers one of the reader's emoji.

emoji_own.visible.value.description: A value of whether the picker offers one of the reader's emoji: on or off, as the administrators' screen says it.

emoji_own.save.description: The button of the submit bar of one of the reader's emoji.

emoji_own.save.refused.defaultMessage: 未儲存任何內容。請修正標示的部分後再試一次。
emoji_own.save.refused.description: Beside Save or Send request when a field was refused, which is marked under it.

emoji_own.save.failed.defaultMessage: 未儲存任何內容。請檢查網路連線後再試一次。
emoji_own.save.failed.description: Beside Save or Send request when it failed with no field named.

emoji_own.delete.description: The heading of the last section of one of the reader's emoji, apart, which deletes it.

emoji_own.delete.about.defaultMessage: 使用過它的貼文和個人檔案會把它的 :shortcode: 顯示為文字，且本月的申請額度不會退還。此操作無法復原。
emoji_own.delete.about.description: Under the heading of the section that deletes one of the reader's emoji.

emoji_own.delete.press.description: The button that deletes one of the reader's emoji, and the confirmation of its question.

emoji_own.delete.title.description: The question before deleting one of the reader's emoji (its shortcode between colons).

emoji_own.delete.text.defaultMessage: 表情符號及其圖片會永久刪除，無法復原。
emoji_own.delete.text.description: Under the question before deleting one of the reader's emoji.

emoji_own.delete.cancel.description: The button that closes the question before deleting one of the reader's emoji, keeping it.
